name: Evershine

narrative.details:
Rejold Barleybrew experiments with his brews.  Some of them taste good, some bad, and some...well, some will lay all but the stoutest dwarf flat.

He lives at Brewnall Village, west of Kharanos, and one of his drinks, Evershine, is what I want.  It'll help keep me warm while I'm on the cold road.

And...the blessed stuff burns so hot I can throw it in Jetsteam's furnace for a burst of power!  That little tactic has gotten me out of more than one tight spot.
narrative.objectives: Get a cask of Evershine from Rejold Barleybrew in Brewnall Village.
narrative.offerRewardText: Bellowfiz needs some of my Evershine? Hm...all right.

chain.subtitle: 4 quests from level 6 to 8, 2,235 XP in all.

quests.name: Stocking Jetsteam
quests.objectiveText: Gather 4 Chunks of Boar Meat and 2 Thick Bear Furs, and deliver them to Pilot Bellowfiz at Steelgrill's Depot.

quests.name: Evershine
quests.objectiveText: Get a cask of Evershine from Rejold Barleybrew in Brewnall Village.

quests.name: A Favor for Evershine
quests.objectiveText: Kill 6 Ice Claw Bears, 8 Elder Crag Boars, and 8 Snow Leopards, and then return to Rejold Barleybrew in Brewnall Village.

quests.name: Return to Bellowfiz
quests.objectiveText: Give the cask of Evershine to Pilot Bellowfiz at Steelgrill's Depot.
